## Approach

For this one I think I will stick with US census data. This will give me the ability to trim the data as well as tidy it. Just for the purposes of this project, I will focus on two age groups, or demographics and collect data based on that to compare trends and statistics between the two. The downside could be taking a couple iterations to find interesting relational data.

However, food security employment, and depression rates will be top contenders
